description: Watch the crypto market for 24 hours: up to 10 conditions (price, % change, funding, open interest, liquidations, order book, Fear and Greed, whale orders, news impact), checked every minute; when one happens you get a signed webhook and it shows in the watch's status. Costs USD 0.02, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); a request that fails is not charged. Keep the returned secret: watch_status and stop_watch need it.

callback_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed POST when the watch fires. Without it, poll the status. A Slack or Discord incoming-webhook URL, or https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<id>, gets a readable message.

op.description: above: value >= threshold; below: value <= threshold. Events use above.

token.description: Ticker such as BTC. Required for token metrics; "*" (any coin) or a ticker for whale_order_usd and news_impact; omitted for fear_greed.

value.description: Threshold, in the metric's own unit (percent for *_pct, USD for *_usd).

format.description: How the callback is sent; detected from the callback host when left out (json for any other host).

label.description: Optional name for your own reference (up to 80 characters).

name: create_watch
title: Create Watch
